research_notes: At validation stage, five clean runs is an initial minimum rather than proof of a stationary platform limit.
Confidence should be described empirically rather than overstated statistically from tiny samples.
A rolling health check can later detect degradation and trigger cap rollback.
The rollback rule should be simpler than the promotion rule so safety reacts quickly to repeated failures.
A single clearly independent outage should be excluded rather than causing needless cap collapse.
Ambiguous repeated failures should bias toward safety until classified.
